name: Large File Upload
coreBlueprint: Clients upload large files directly to object storage via short-lived presigned URLs, split into resumable multipart chunks. App servers never touch the bytes - they only issue URLs and track metadata. A completion event triggers asynchronous processing such as virus scanning, text extraction and thumbnails.

keyComponents.name: Upload API
keyComponents.role: Authenticates the client, creates the upload session and hands out presigned part URLs.

keyComponents.name: Object Storage
keyComponents.role: Durably stores the file bytes; assembles multipart chunks into one object.

keyComponents.name: Metadata Database
keyComponents.role: Tracks owner, size, checksum and upload status (PENDING, UPLOADED, READY).

keyComponents.name: Message Queue
keyComponents.role: Carries upload-completed events so processing is decoupled from the upload path.

keyComponents.name: Processing Workers
keyComponents.role: Scan, extract text and generate previews before the file is marked READY.
